title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
description: Investigator Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise) goes on the lam to uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy that involves the death of U.S. soldiers.

title: Crimes of the Future
description: As the human species adapts to a synthetic environment, the body undergoes new transformations and mutations. Accompanied by his partner, celebrity performance artist Saul Tenser showcases the metamorphosis of his organs.

title: Kiss the Girls
description: After escaping from a serial killer, a doctor (Ashley Judd) helps police and a forensic psychologist (Morgan Freeman) track the madman.

title: The Saint
description: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist.

title: Rock of Ages
description: Songs by Def Leppard, Journey, Joan Jett, Bon Jovi and others underscore a rock 'n' roll romance between a small-town girl (Julianne Hough) and a city boy (Diego Boneta) who meet on the Sunset Strip while chasing their Hollywood dreams.

title: The Addams Family
description: When a man claiming to be Fester, the missing brother of Gomez Addams, arrives at the Addams' home, the family is thrilled. Morticia begins to suspect the man is a fraud, since he cannot recall details of Fester's life.

title: True Grit
description: A teenage girl (Hailee Steinfeld) enlists the aid of a boozy, trigger-happy lawman (Jeff Bridges) to hunt down her father's killer (Josh Brolin).

title: Old School
description: Three friends try to recapture the fun of their college years by starting their own off-campus fraternity.

title: Godzilla
description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation.

title: V for Vendetta
description: After world war leads to a fascist government, a vigilante known as V (Hugo Weaving) uses terrorist tactics to fight the totalitarian state in which he now lives.

title: Se7en
description: A meticulous detective and the young officer about to replace the veteran probe serial murders based on the seven deadly sins.

title: Troy
description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy.
Sparta's King Leonidas (Gerard Butler) and his badly outnumbered warriors fight to the death against King Xerxes' massive Persian army at the Battle of Thermopylae.

title: 300: Rise of an Empire
description: Xerxes, driven by vengeance for his father's death, leads an army against Greece; Greek city-states join forces under Athens' command to fight Artemisia in a naval battle.

title: Piranha
description: Spring break turns gory at a popular waterside resort, where hundreds of prehistoric man-eating fish have come to dine on hapless humans.

title: Noah
description: God chooses Noah (Russell Crowe) to build an ark and save the animals and his family from an apocalyptic flood.

title: Daddy's Home
description: An insecure man (Will Ferrell) competes for the affection of his stepchildren when their freewheeling father (Mark Wahlberg) breezes back into town.

title: The Bodyguard
description: An ex-secret service agent falls for his client, an actress and singer someone wants dead before the Academy Awards.

title: Dunkirk
description: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found.

title: Argo
description: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador.

title: I Was a Stranger
description: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries.

title: Hostage
description: A former hostage negotiator (Bruce Willis) must take action when three carjackers hold a wealthy man (Kevin Pollak) and his children at gunpoint.

title: Apocalypse Now Redux
description: An Army agent (Martin Sheen) goes upriver into the heart of Cambodia to kill a renegade colonel (Marlon Brando).

title: MobLand
description:
S02 E05 — Birdland
Conrad declares war, stacking bodies and turning the Cotswolds into a fortress; Maeve plays puppet-master, sending Eddie on a mission before secrets start to spill, and a hit hurtles the Harrigans into all-out chaos.

title: Pulp Fiction
description: Two hit men (John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson), a boxer, a crime boss and others meet their fates over the course of two days.

title: Argo
description: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador.

title: Horrible Bosses
description: Three oppressed workers (Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis) devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their intolerable employers.

title: Horrible Bosses 2
description: After a shady investor steals their new invention, Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) conspire to kidnap the man's adult son and ransom him to pay off their debts.

title: Love & Basketball
description: From childhood to early adulthood, two friends (Sanaa Lathan, Omar Epps) fall in love while trying to establish basketball careers.

title: Molly's Game
description: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe.

title: A Simple Plan
description: A Minnesotan (Bill Paxton), his dimwitted brother (Billy Bob Thornton) and his brother's redneck friend (Brent Briscoe) find and decide to keep $4 million.

title: Scream 2
description: A masked killer continues to pursue a California student (Neve Campbell) and her friends at an Ohio college.

title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
description: The owner (Vince Vaughn) of a gym and an overbearing entrepreneur (Ben Stiller) form dodgeball teams to compete for $50,000 in Las Vegas.

title: Magic Mike
description: A male stripper takes a newcomer under his wing and instructs him in the fine arts of partying, picking up women and making plenty of money.

title: The Intern
description: Dissatisfied with retirement, a 70-year-old widower becomes an intern at an online fashion site and develops a special bond with his young boss.

title: Colossal
description: When a giant creature starts destroying Seoul, South Korea, a woman learns that she is somehow connected to the phenomenon. She must now figure out why her seemingly insignificant existence is having such a colossal effect on the fate of the world.

title: We're the Millers
description: Indebted to a big-time drug lord, a pot dealer travels to Mexico with a fake family and a camper to pick up a large shipment and smuggle it into the U.S.

title: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
description: Three Boy Scouts (Tye Sheridan, Logan Miller, Joey Morgan) join forces with a tough cocktail waitress (Sarah Dumont) to save their once-peaceful town from a zombie invasion.

title: Overlord
description: Paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate a fortified church and destroy a Nazi transmitter. Making their way to an underground lab, the soldiers stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a battle against an army of the undead.

title: Wildling
description: After a childhood in captivity under the care of a man who taught her to fear the outside world, a young woman sees her new freedom shattered by a series of unsettling events.

title: Case 39
description: A social worker (Renée Zellweger) saves a girl (Jodelle Ferland) from abusive parents but finds there is more to the child than meets the eye.

title: The Ring
description: A journalist (Naomi Watts) investigates the mystery behind a bizarre videotape that brings death after seven days to all who view it.

title: Drag Me to Hell
description: After actions trigger the loss of an old woman's home, an ambitious loan officer finds herself the victim of a curse that will damn her soul for eternity.

title: Bridget Jones's Diary
description: An outrageous British woman (Renée Zellweger) decides to take control of her life, but instead falls for two very different men (Colin Firth, Hugh Grant).
